xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesToAnnexure1Ex: The report of the previous quarter viz 31.12.2025 was placed before the Board in the Board Meeting held on 30.01.2026 and this report shall be placed in the next Board Meeting of the Company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnAffirmation: The Listed Entity has adopted a Policy on Material Subsidiaries in accordance with applicable compliance requirements; however, the Company did not have any material subsidiary during the reporting period.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Notice was issued under The Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996 vide case No. 1808 & 1809 and CR No. EN/2780/2025
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Violation under the Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996 and the Notice was issued vide case No. 1808 & 1809 and CR No. EN/2780/2025
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on the financial or on the operations of the Company. The Company has already paid the penalty of Rs. 3000/- imposed by the Authority and the case is closed now.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Hon’ble High Court of Judicature at Bombay, Civil Appellate Jurisdiction, vide its Order dated October 7, 2023, The Arbitration Tribunal has been formed and the matter is being heard by the Tribunal.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company has already filed its Statement of Claims and Affidavit of its witness to the Arbitral Tribunal. The cross examination of witnesses of both parties have also been completed.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: In the matter of Arbitration Petition No. 89 of 2021, Hon’ble High Court of Judicature at Bombay, Civil Appellate Jurisdiction, at its hearing held on December 07, 2022, after hearing the arguments of both the parties, reserved the matter for passing its judgement. The Hon’ble High Court pronounced its judgement on January 27, 2023 wherein it has directed that an Arbitral Tribunal of 3 (three) members be constituted. The Arbitral Tribunal has been formed and the matter is being heard by the Arbitral Tribunal.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Arbitral Tribunal has pronounced the Arbitration Award on January 11, 2026. Under the Award, the Arbitral Tribunal has directed the BNCMC (“Respondent”) to pay to the Company (“Claimant”), Principal amount of Rs. 61,44,17,413/- along with an Interest accrued up to the date of award, as specified therein, within 60(Sixty) days from the date of this award. In case the Respondent fails to pay the said amount within the stipulated period, the Respondent shall be liable to pay future Interest @ 11% p.a. on the awarded amount + accrued interest as on the date of award, from the date of award to the date of actual payment. The arbitration proceedings now stand concluded.
